capability: Map every part and what it calls
title: See every joint first.

hook.picture: Close on the whale nudging one small card in a tangle of grey cards and threads.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: We changed one small module and five teams broke.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: engineering director the morning after a release

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: the tangle fills the frame. Three more small changes, every 2 beats, then 1, then half; each sends crosses somewhere new.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Nobody can see what leans on what.

stakes.body: Every release becomes a gamble, and teams stop changing anything at all.

solution_hint: Map every part and what it calls.

metaphor.body: The codebase is a web of cards hanging from the line; draw every link as an arrow from the part that calls to the part it needs, and the knots and loops stand out like snags in a net.

steps.picture: The tangle spreads out: cards placed apart, each link redrawn as a straight arrow from caller to called.

steps.words: Every part. Every link it calls.

steps.picture: Three cards whose arrows run in a circle light up; a raw sienna flag rises on the loop.

steps.words: A loop means nothing changes alone.

steps.picture: The whale moves one arrow; the circle opens and the flag lowers.
One card with many arrows out and none in glows heavy: it leans on everything.

real_case.claim: catreview-go: 5 real-world repositories analyzed (5,055 objects, 8,141 morphisms); morphisms are dependencies, calls and imports. Example run: Cycles Found: 0.

honest_limit.picture: A second line of cards in another language drifts past; its cards stay grey, no arrows are drawn, and a pod reads it anyway.
honest_limit.words: Only Go code gets mapped today.

not_this.body: A clean map is not working code.

ending_pattern.body: FELT framing: the whale nudges the same small card. One arrow lights to its single neighbour, whose pod blinks once and stays green; the other four pods keep their ticks.
ending_pattern.callback: The cascade of five crosses in bar 3 becomes one warned neighbour, in the same close framing.

end_belief.body: Check what leans on it before changing.

score_self.reason: Leaders feel the five-teams-broke pain directly; the map picture is clear. Weakness: card numbers use plain words for objects and morphisms, and the limit (Go only) is a tool limit more than a concept limit.
